explanation: Euler's update is y_{n+1}=(1-(3/2)Δx)y_n, without exponent n, so I is false. Stability requires |1-(3/2)Δx|<1, equivalent to 0<Δx<4/3, so II is true. At Δx=0.3 and Δx=1, the amplification factors are 0.55 and -0.5, respectively, both with magnitude less than 1. Thus III is true and IV is false.
